name: Match page response includes X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, the HTTP response carries either an X-Frame-Options header or a CSP frame-ancestors directive.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Inspect the network response headers for the document
Verify the response carries either an X-Frame-Options header or a Content-Security-Policy header containing a frame-ancestors directive
